Class Basis

java.lang.Object
solvers.basis.Basis
Direct Known Subclasses:
CoMoMBasis
public abstract class Basis extends Object
A class to encapsulate the basis of CoMoM (or MoM). Storage and access to the normalising constants is provided
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
